//: Marks every .js under static/js/ as an ES module for Node's loader. The browser already loads these via <script type="module"> and ignores this file; Node (used by tests/js/*.test.mjs and the array-stats guard) otherwise resolves a bare .js as CommonJS and chokes on `export`. Co-locating this here lets shared util modules be authored once and run in both the browser and Node with no per-file .mjs rename. No build step is implied or added.
